_doc: t/246 iteration-2 held-out gold set. Fresh draw, disjoint from heldout_labels.json (run 1, now spent). Labelled by CL blind to existing labels, from the classifier's inputs (description + per-POV summary), rubric §2 + §2.2, broad structural (PI 2026-11-11). Labelled BEFORE candidate_v9.prompt was written, and committed before any v9 run.
drawn_by: seeded random draw (seed 5246) from live situations.json; strata by existing label (14 interpretive, 10 structural, 6 unlabelled); excludes the 10 rubric seeds, sit-484..493, superseded nodes and run 1's 30 ids. Note: only 1 of the 10 drawn from the existing-structural stratum is CL-structural.
